conbody.p: With the X-Author Contracts for Cloud User Guide, you can find out how Apttus X-Author Contracts for Cloud works and how to manage your organization's and your customers' contracts.

entry.p: This guide walks the X-Author Contracts for Cloud user through an entire contract lifecycle inside Microsoft Word while complying with approval workflows and using the latest terms and clauses from your legal playbook. It covers step-by-step instructions, and use cases for the features provided by X-Author for Contracts for Cloud.
Individuals who are working on any aspect of contracts: contract managers, contract creators, contract negotiators, and contract reviewers
